screen.no_player: Choose a Music Assistant player for this tile in the editor to play it here.

app.name: Album of the day
app.summary: One album a day from Apple Music's 100 Best Albums, with a key that plays it on your speakers.
app.also_hint: Optional. A speaker that plays along: it is grouped with the tile's player when you press Play.
app.order_hint: Count down from number 100 to number 1, or go through the list in a mixed order. Either way every album comes once in a hundred days.
app.background_hint: The card behind the tile: the usual one, none at all so the cover stands on the page itself, or a soft colour.
